name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Getting Started with GitHub Copilot in CLI
short_description: Kickstart your journey with GitHub Copilot in the CLI! This tutorial provides essential insights and practical tips for leveraging Copilot's capabilities to enhance your command-line experience.
author: LadyKerr

sections.overview:
This skill provides a comprehensive tutorial on leveraging GitHub Copilot directly in the command line interface. Learn practical techniques and essential insights for using Copilot to write, explain, and optimize CLI commands more efficiently. The guide covers real-world examples and best practices presented at GitHub Universe 2023, helping developers reduce time spent searching for correct command syntax and focusing more on solving problems.
Integrating Copilot into CLI workflows
Automating repetitive command-line tasks
Enhancing coding speed with AI suggestions
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install LadyKerr/cli-skills-copilot-talk`
`git clone https://github.com/LadyKerr/cli-skills-copilot-talk`
To get started, install the GitHub Copilot CLI by running the following command:
```bash
brew install github/copilot/copilot
```
